title: Abbest - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Abbest in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

facts.label: Areas
facts.value: Spring Meadows, Flying Waters, The Monolith

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: A robed caster Nevron that appears from the early game onward. It resists Physical, so a purely physical party loses a large share of its damage against it.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toIce
ResistsPhysical
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneNone

Bring Ice damage. Physical is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: Where to Find the Abbest
sections.content: Areas: Spring Meadows, Flying Waters, The Monolith.

sections.title: How to Beat the Abbest
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Ice is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It resists Physical, so that damage is halved.
